Source   Edit  

SlackAdapter — ChannelPort for Slack Events API (webhook / Socket Mode).

Receiving: Events arrive via HTTP POST from Slack to a webhook endpoint. The HTTP layer calls pushEvent() with the parsed JSON payload. The daemon calls tryRecvEvent() (non-blocking) in its main loop.

URL verification: Slack sends a url_verification challenge on first setup. Call parseChallenge(payload) — non-empty result means echo it back as-is.

Sending: Slack Web API POST /api/chat.postMessage using bot token. DM channel IDs are fetched on first send via conversations.open and cached.

Slash commands arrive form-encoded; the HTTP layer must JSON-encode them and set "type": "slash_command" before calling pushEvent().
